The 1950–51 season was '''[[Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]''''s [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|48th season]] in existence and the club's 19th consecutive season in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
During the summer [[Santiago Bernabéu (footballer)|Santiago Bernabéu]] signed two French footballers, Jean Luciano and Louis Hon, from [[OGC Nice]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/blogs/ni-mas-ni-menos/2018/05/28/louis-hon-un-muro-frances-para-el-madrid.html|title=Hon, A French Wall for Real  Madrid|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=28 May 2018|accessdate=15 July 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> [[Michael Keeping]] was sacked<ref>{{cite web|url=http://kranten.kb.nl/view/article/id/ddd%3A010678495%3Ampeg21%3Ap006%3Aa0124|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130413214845/http://kranten.kb.nl/view/article/id/ddd:010678495:mpeg21:p006:a0124|url-status=dead|archive-date=13 April 2013|title=Sport in T'Kort (Sports in Brief)|accessdate=31 December 2012|date=9 August 1960|publisher=Nieuwsblad van het Noorden|language=Dutch}}</ref> on 23 October by Bernabéu after three massive losses against [[Real Sociedad]], [[FC Barcelona]] and [[Deportivo La Coruña]]. The club appointed [[Baltasar Albeniz]] who could not improve the situation and was sacked on 5 March after a 0–4 defeat to [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2009/05/08/mas_futbol/1241764044_850215.html|title=Di Stefano had said that They were nervous towards us|publisher=as.com|date=8 May 2009|accessdate=1 July 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> Then, Bernabeu brought Uruguayan head coach [[Hector Scarone]] who managed the team to ninth, avoiding relegation to the [[Segunda División|Second Division]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2018/10/30/5bd854b6468aeb72518b45c1.html|title=When changing coach mid-season has worked for Real madrid|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=30 October 2018|accessdate=1 July 2020}}</ref>

Real reached the [[1951 Copa del Generalísimo]] semi-finals and were defeated by [[Real Sociedad]] 0–3 on aggregate.
